title: What is RAG? AI with an open book

lines.say: Your chatbot just lied to you, confidently.
lines.text: Your chatbot just lied to you. Confidently.

lines.say: Three letters fix a lot of that: rag.
lines.text: Three letters fix a lot of that: *RAG*.

lines.say: A model reads a mountain of text, once.
Then its knowledge freezes, like my gym progress.
lines.text: Then its knowledge *freezes*. Like my gym progress.

lines.say: Ask about your files? It guesses.

lines.say: Rag turns every question into an open-book exam.
lines.text: RAG turns every question into an open-book exam.

lines.say: Before it answers, it looks things up.
lines.text: Before it answers, it *looks things up*.

lines.say: In your documents, not just its memory.
Your question goes to search first.
Like an office where only three people know.
lines.text: Like an office where only *three* people know.

lines.say: The model reads them, then answers.
No retraining: just update the documents.
And it can cite its sources.
Unlike me in every argument.
Rag is only as good as its search.
lines.text: RAG is only as good as its search.

lines.say: Messy documents in, messy answers out.
So clean that folder called final final two.
Comment rag for the cheat sheet.
Follow for more AI, minus the jargon.
lines.text: *Follow* for more AI, minus the jargon.

lines.say: Your chatbot: still confident, now also right.
lines.text: Your chatbot? Still confident. Now also right.
